terms.gloss: an ell, a length measured on the arm; Traupman’s word for the yard
terms.comment: Literally the forearm (see forearm); as a measure, an ell. Lewis & Short notes that Pliny also uses it for a fathom, as much as a man can clasp with both arms.

sources: Lewis & Short: ulna
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency (printed page numbers): p. 409.
